cohort: 50 pregnant women with fibroids (5cm and above) admitted to Jawaharlal Nehru Medical College and Hospital in Bhagalpur, Bihar, India
finding: Pregnancies complicated by fibroids are associated with increased risks of various complications including pain, threatened preterm labor, miscarriage, anemia, placenta previa, cesarean delivery, and postpartum hemorrhage.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery rate was higher (61.36%) in women with fibroids compared to vaginal delivery (27.27%), with additional interventions like forceps (4.5%) and ventouse (4.5%) also reported.
gest_age: 88% of the pregnancies reached 37 completed weeks of gestation.
birth_weight: All babies born to the study participants weighed above 2.5 kg.
